font-size: 20px;"><div style="line-height: 230%;"><div style="line-height: 230%;">def insertion_sort(arr):</div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;for i in <font color="#cc0000">range(1, len(arr))</font>:</div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; key = arr[i]</div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; j = i - 1</div><div style="line-height: 230%;"><br></div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; while <font color="#cc0000">j &gt;= 0 and arr[j] &gt; key:</font></div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; arr[j + 1] = arr[j]</div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; j -= 1</div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; arr[j + 1] = key</div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; return arr</div></div></div>"
